summary: I'm a full-stack software engineer from Oceanside, California. I have industry experience in software engineering with experience in system design and enterprise-scale agentic development covering full-stack applications.
paragraphs: Hello, I'm Jaedon! I'm a software engineer with a passion for building products that solve problems at scale.
Currently, I work at Lockheed Martin in Orlando, Florida building software to help automate business processes.
In my free time, I enjoy rock climbing, skiing, hiking, muay thai, and reading philosophy or historical classics.
